The house

An established family estate in the hills above San José — mature gardens, a long lawn and a pool that catches the last light.

Villa Marielle is the kind of house that has been quietly improved for thirty years: thick walls, deep terraces, and a garden that has had time to grow. The main house holds six bedrooms; a separate casita sleeps four more.

There is a proper lawn for children, a shaded pergola for lunch, and a pool terrace that faces west. It is five minutes from San José, and fifteen from the coast.
